channel.title: What NBA players and coaches have said about Carlos Boozer | HoopsMatic
channel.description: The latest quotes about Carlos Boozer from NBA players, coaches and executives, with context and sources.

item.title: Deron Williams on Carlos Boozer, Jerry Sloan
item.description:
Deron Williams on playing for the legendary Jerry Sloan and his toughness and coaching style:

“Do you know how much dummy offense we did? Man, so we would do it...some days we would come in, and he’d put me at the five and he’d put Booze [Carlos Boozer] at the one. You had to know, he wanted you to know every position so that everything was interchangeable. And that’s how good we run it. That’s what made it so successful, is how hard we ran it and how well we ran it.”

Deron Williams on Carlos Boozer, Jerry Sloan, Dec 8, 2020. Source: The Players' Tribune.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson
item.description:
“We're not starting from scratch... We still have Noah and Derrick and (Mike) Dunleavy and Taj Gibson and (Carlos) Boozer.”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Mike Dunleavy, Derrick Rose, Joakim Noah, Taj Gibson, Jan 28, 2014. Source: Twitter @stevekylerNBA.

item.title: Dwyane Wade on Carlos Boozer
item.description:
Wade on Boozer's comment about Heat having 2 great players:

“I was glad he said that about Chris... He's responded to it.”

Dwyane Wade on Carlos Boozer, May 23, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Carlos Boozer
item.description:
Mike McGraw:Thibodeau on Carlos Boozer:

“We’ve got to search him out a little bit better. I think we’ve got to get him more looks.”

Tom Thibodeau on Carlos Boozer, May 20, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Carlos Boozer
item.description:
KC Johnson:Thibs on not playing Boozer in 4th:

“We were behind big and they were zoning. Playing Deng at the four gave us another perimeter player.”

Tom Thibodeau on Carlos Boozer, Jan 6, 2011. Source: Twitter.

item.title: Tom Thibodeau on Carlos Boozer, Derrick Rose
item.description:
“That's going to make a big difference for the offense—when we get into our halfcourt sets, we are going to be much tougher to guard. Teams won't be able to focus on Derrick. If you can have a big man who runs the pick-and-roll like Carlos, you are going to have a big advantage. That's going to make Derrick a much better player.”

Tom Thibodeau on Carlos Boozer, Derrick Rose, Aug 19, 2010. Source: Sporting News.

item.title: Kyle Korver on Carlos Boozer
item.description:
If the Orlando Magic match the offer sheet that the Bulls gave J.J. Redick, you can bet the Bulls will go hard after Brewer.

“[Boozer] reached out to me and we talked about it for sure,”

Kyle Korver on Carlos Boozer, Jul 14, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer
item.description:
But Bulls chairman Jerry Reinsdorf told ESPNChicago.com's Melissa Isaacson that there are no hard feelings.

“We actually had discussed a trade for Carlos over the last couple of years,”

Jerry Reinsdorf on Carlos Boozer, Jul 9, 2010. Source: ESPN.com.

item.title: Paul Millsap on Carlos Boozer
item.description:
Millsap is confident that he’s ready.

“Carlos Boozer is a great player, and he’ll be tough to replace, no doubt. Him leaving is a tough loss. But I think I can help this team win, period,”

Paul Millsap on Carlos Boozer, Jul 9, 2010. Source: Salt Lake Tribune.
